summary: Leclerc hunts Antonelli's Mercedes pace as Ferrari seeks to close the championship gap on a treacherous Austin circuit riddled with track bumps that have drawn Verstappen's ire. Antonelli, on the brink of the title, aims to neutralize the Scuderia's Friday momentum while managing tire degradation across a surface that's punishing even the sport's best. A dominant performance here could mathematically settle the championship fight, making every tenth decisive in the championship's defining weekend.
